trials.claim: Automates Google Sheets for budgets, dashboards, reporting, sales and CRM with AI
trials.claimQuote: Automate Google Sheets: Budgets, Dashboards, Reporting, Sales, CRM! And, use AI before it uses you.
trials.reasoning: The defense is only vendor marketing listing dashboards, budgets and reports, with no independent evidence for sales, CRM or AI automation, while reviews describe just a Loom video library offering little beyond a Google search.

exhibits.quote: It's just a Loom video library that doesn't look like many people get much use from.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows product is a basic video library with low usage, contradicting claim of comprehensive AI automation for budgets, dashboards, CRM and reporting.

exhibits.quote: Being a somewhat power user didn't offered me much I must say that a google search wouldn't solve immediately.
exhibits.argument: Quote indicates content offers little beyond free Google searches, undermining claim of advanced automation capabilities.

exhibits.quote: Create better trackers, planners, dashboards, budgets, reports, automations, graphs, charts,
exhibits.argument: Quote lists dashboards, budgets and reports among automations taught, matching the claimed automation scope.

exhibits.quote: Automate invoices, reports, analytics, emails, and more. Master every to automate your sheets. And add AI!
exhibits.argument: Vendor explicitly promises to automate sheets and add AI, supporting the AI automation claim.

trials.claim: Save hours every day with tips and tricks
trials.claimQuote: Save hours every day with tips and tricks
trials.reasoning: The vendor merely restates that walkthroughs save hours, with no evidence of hours saved every day, and a review shows topics are trivial formatting tricks like column width and emojis.

exhibits.quote: They cover very specific uses, like "4 Ways to Change Column Width", or "How do I Insert Emojis into Google Sheets?"
exhibits.argument: Quote shows tutorials cover trivial formatting tricks rather than time-saving automation that would save hours daily.

exhibits.quote: In my case, it's an unnecessary purchase. Foreign customers, if you don't speak English, don't bother.
exhibits.argument: Quote reports purchase was unnecessary and unusable for non-English speakers, contradicting universal hours-saved benefit.

exhibits.quote: Use proven tools and walkthroughs to save hours inside Google Sheets.
exhibits.argument: Vendor directly claims its tools and walkthroughs save hours inside Google Sheets.

trials.claim: Includes Google Sheets templates to create a storefront with buyable products
trials.claimQuote: Create a storefront with buyable products with our Google Sheets Templates
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes turning sheets into sellable products, monetizing templates, and connecting payments to access, which directly supports buyable products; the prosecution exhibits do not deny payment-connected selling.

exhibits.quote: Turn a spreadsheet into a website. Make catalogs, directories, galleries from your data. Share a public URL.
exhibits.argument: Quote describes only catalogs/directories/galleries via public URL, not a storefront with buyable products and checkout.

exhibits.quote: The only thing missing is a way to embed a googlesheet on a live web page, which is something I really need.
exhibits.argument: Quote reports inability to embed sheets on live web page, undermining claim of creating a functional buyable storefront.

exhibits.quote: Turn Google Sheets into sellable products. Learn to advertise your sheets to the right people. Protect your intellectual property.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states sheets can be turned into sellable products, supporting storefront with buyable products via templates.

exhibits.quote: Monetize templates, planners, and workflows. Keep proprietary data safe. Connect payments to people's access.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes monetizing templates and connecting payments to access, which is creating a storefront with buyable products.

trials.claim: Makes you appear as a Google Sheets guru
trials.claimQuote: Make everyone think you're some sort of Google Sheets guru
trials.reasoning: A 5-star buyer says everyone at work thinks they are an advanced guru, exactly matching the claim, and the prosecution exhibits about the founder or refunds do not undercut that buyer outcome.

exhibits.quote: Not really an expert. I asked him how to convert numbers into words, but he was unable to do it.
exhibits.argument: Quote directly contradicts guru status by reporting founder could not solve a basic Sheets task.

exhibits.quote: I regret buying it - Wouldn't have purchased if I realized there was no refunds.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows buyer regret and lack of perceived expertise value, undermining guru appearance claim.

exhibits.quote: everyone at my work thinks I'm some sort of advanced guru.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the product made coworkers perceive them as an advanced guru, exactly as claimed.

trials.claim: Become faster, more productive, and more engaged in work
trials.claimQuote: Become faster, more productive, and more engaged in your work
trials.reasoning: Two 5-star reviews report automation enhancing productivity and saved time with improved workflow, outweighing the prosecution's language-access and low-use complaints.

exhibits.quote: Not suitable for non-English speakers. I'm redoing my comment since AppSumo didn't validate the previous one.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows product is inaccessible without English subtitles, preventing productivity gains for many users.

exhibits.quote: It's just a Loom video library that doesn't look like many people get much use from.
exhibits.argument: Quote indicates low engagement and limited utility, contradicting claim of becoming more productive and engaged.

exhibits.quote: Automation Focus: Comprehensive coverage of Google Apps Scripts to automate repetitive tasks and enhance productivity.
exhibits.argument: Review confirms automation coverage enhances productivity, supporting the become more productive claim.

exhibits.quote: provides real down to earth value and solutions to customers with common real world solutions to saved time and money by solving problems and improving their workflow.
exhibits.argument: Review reports saved time and improved workflow, supporting faster and more productive work.
